content:
I just pushed the initial commit of the Lean 4 formalization of "Logic Notes" by Lou van den Dries, which is the textbook for a class I'm taking this semester. Currently there are complete proofs for Lindenbaum's lemma and two versions each of the completeness and compactness theorems for propositional logic. Custom syntax for making logical Prop's (distinct from the base logic Prop) easier to write is also in the works. That's only about 10% of the textbook content though, and any contributions or advice would be greatly appreciated!

Textbook link: https://www.studocu.vn/vn/document/truong-dai-hoc-cong-nghiep-thanh-pho-ho-chi-minh/cau-truc-roi-rac/logic-math/34117438
